prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal 4:5 1990s disposable-camera portrait of an adult woman, optionally matching an approved adult identity reference. She has loose black hair, pale soft natural complexion, a calm relaxed look, and wears an oversized pastel-lavender hoodie with a softly worn texture and no printed graphics. Frame her chest-up as she lightly adjusts plain black sunglasses. Place her before a wall densely covered in blank-border instant photos fixed with pale tape; every photo is abstract, out of focus, and has no readable writing. Use gentle direct flash, warm nostalgic tone, subtle film grain, slight softness, natural skin, and no text, logos, or watermark.
